subgoals.objective_name: To identify organizational assets and define appropriate protection responsibilities.
subgoals.goal_name: Identify organizational assets and define appropriate protection responsibilities

subgoals.control_name: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

subgoals.goal_name: Identify assets associated with information and information processing facilities and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up
Maintain assets associated with information and information processing facilities

subgoals.control_name: Assets maintained in the inventory shall be owned.

subgoals.goal_name: Ensure assets maintained in the inventory are owned

subgoals.control_name: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

subgoals.goal_name: Identify rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities
Document rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities
Implement rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities

subgoals.control_name: All employees and external party users shall return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

subgoals.goal_name: Return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement
